Implemented and pushed for review: https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/c/rebar/+/1056 (commit 020038055, Change-Id If8b30699f6d5e1063f0578902a67334b84f712b8).

Change: .github/workflows/_build-and-test.yml test-job default-suite step now selects the coverage flags per-OS; docs/coverage.md gained a 'CI collects coverage on the ubuntu cells only' section recording the rationale and the measurements.

Implementation note worth keeping: the flags are selected as
  ${{ !startsWith(matrix.os, 'macos') && '--cov=rebar --cov-report=term-missing:skip-covered' || '' }}
NOT the more natural-reading
  ${{ matrix.os == 'macos-latest' && '' || '--cov=...' }}
The second form is a silent no-op: GitHub Actions treats the empty string as FALSY, so 'a && "" || b' evaluates to b on BOTH branches and coverage would still have been collected on macOS. Putting the empty branch in the || slot avoids that.

Local verification (worktree ../ci-macos-nocov, venv on PATH):
  make lint                                    PASS (ruff check + format, actionlint over all workflows, zizmor, dco/criteria checks)
  make typecheck                               PASS (mypy, 398 source files)
  pytest test_ci_workflow_parity.py            6 passed
  pytest test_workflow_names.py + 3 others     62 passed total
  scripts/check_verify_gate_parity.py          OK (vote.needs covers all 6 gating jobs)
  yaml.safe_load of the workflow               folds to a single-line command as intended

Not yet verified: the actual macOS speedup. That is observational and this change's own Verified run is the measurement — compare its 'pytest (macos-latest, py3.13)' default-suite step against the 15.4m baseline from run #1823 (id 30569775555), and confirm the pass count is still 7856 and that the ubuntu cells still print a coverage report.
